title: High Protein Honey Roasted Peanut Butter Protein Balls
description: These no-bake energy bites combine honey-roasted peanut butter and whey protein for a quick, macro-friendly snack. Each batch is easy to mix and store for your weekly meal prep.
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine 135 g rolled oats, 50 g vanilla whey protein powder, 20 g chia seeds, and 1 g salt using a rubber spatula until evenly distributed.
Add 130 g honey-roasted peanut butter and 85 g honey to the dry mixture.
Stir vigorously with a sturdy spoon for 2 minutes until a thick, uniform, and slightly sticky dough forms with no dry pockets remaining.
Scoop out portions using a 1-tablespoon cookie scoop and roll between your palms for 30 seconds each until compact, smooth spherical balls are formed.
Transfer the finished balls to an airtight container and refrigerate for 30 minutes until firm to the touch.
tips: If the mixture feels too crumbly, add water one teaspoon at a time until it holds its shape.
Swap chia seeds for ground flaxseed if preferred.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 2 months.

issues: The ratio of wet binders (1/2 cup peanut butter + 1/3 cup honey = 245g) to dry ingredients (1 cup oats + 1/3 cup protein powder = 125g) is extremely skewed toward wet ingredients. Standard energy ball ratios require roughly 1 cup of dry base (oats) to 1/2 cup total wet/sticky binders. With 115g of honey and 130g of peanut butter for only 90g of oats, the resulting mixture will be a runny, unrollable batter rather than a dough.
